Hi Elena — thanks for the intake form and docs. Looping in Ben (procurement ops) and Lauren (finance ops) to cover PO setup and billing.

Short answer on your questions:
- Remit: we prefer a remit-to address and vendor bank details for ACH. If you can provide both a remit postal address and ACH instructions on the intake form, that speeds setup.
- PO cadence: Standard PO issuance is within 2 business days once the vendor is approved and the budget code is provided. For ongoing, we can set up blanket POs if you'd like a recurring flow.
- Invoices: PDF invoices are fine; we also accept EDI for larger volume partners (we'll confirm if Greenway qualifies).
- Compliance: We may request an additional DPA or data-handling checklist for integrations. SOC 2 is optional for logistics vendors but we do ask for COI and W-9 (received).

Im attaching our vendor requirements checklist and the PO workflow doc so you can see the fields we need. Could you confirm the vendors legal entity name exactly as it should appear on the W-9, and provide a primary AP contact (name + email)?

Proposed next steps:
1) Greenway confirms legal name + AP contact (Elena?) — action: Greenway (due: Fri 5/14 EOD)
2) Redwood completes internal vendor approval + PO code assignment — action: Ben (due: Mon 5/17 EOD)
3) Kickoff call to review invoicing and delivery SLAs (30m) — propose Tue 5/18 at 10am PDT

Would Tuesday 10am PDT work for you?

Sofia Ivanova
Head of Strategic Procurement (Contracting)
Redwood Inference
